SELECT g.geo_acc_id, g.user_id, g.access_time, g.ip, g.location_id, g.geoname_id, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.acc_radius, g.network, g.asn, g.aso, l.cont_code, l.cont_name, l.ctry_code, l.ctry_name, l.sub1_code, l.sub1_name, l.sub2_code, l.sub2_name, l.city_name, l.time_zone, l.locale_code, l.postcode FROM base.geo_access g LEFT JOIN base.geo_location l ON g.location_id = l.location_id ORDER BY g.access_time DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
